title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust sets a universal standard for trust in embodied navigation, ensuring consistent, reliable AI behavior across all environments.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking allows for continuous improvement, adapting to new challenges—static standards can’t keep up with evolving real-world conditions.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates real-world metrics like collision avoidance and path efficiency, backed by IEEE and ISO validation protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without benchmarking, we risk creating AI that performs well in controlled labs but fails in unpredictable, real-world scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the compass; benchmarking is the map—both are needed, but trust must come first.
